added.summary: Two surface patterns for large-scale value: `facing` masks where the surface faces `axis` (frost on tops, dark undersides, a step per facet), and `gradient` runs along `axis` across every part painted with the material (a dark foot, a pale crown). Both take `threshold` and `softness`.

fixed.summary: A `noise` layer's mask and jitter now span the whole 0..1. Fbm sat between 0.3 and 0.7 nine times in ten, so noise painted nearly one flat tone. Thresholds on noise layers now cut at the stretched value.

fixed.member: model program surface edges and cavities
fixed.summary: `edges` and `cavities` also find creases sharper than 40° within one surface, so a faceted part (a hex column, an eight-sided tower) wears on its corners. Before, only edges between two surfaces counted.
